Base functions that are disabled for jax values

Source: R/methods.R
jax_disabled_base.Rd

c(), rev(), rep(), aperm(), [[, dim<- and length<- raise errors for jax values because they would silently drop dtype information or use R's column-major or 1-based conventions. Use jnp_concatenate(), jnp_flip(), jnp_tile(), jnp_transpose(), x[i] (0-based) and jnp_reshape(), or convert explicitly with as.array().

Usage

# S3 method for class 'jax_value'
c(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'jax_value'
rev(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'jax_value'
rep(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'jax_value'
aperm(a, perm, ...)

# S3 method for class 'jax_value'
x[[...]]

# S3 method for class 'jax_value'
dim(x) <- value

# S3 method for class 'jax_value'
length(x) <- value

Arguments

x

A jax value.

...

Ignored.

a, perm

Ignored.

value

Ignored.
